stem_md: 设 $z=f(x,x^2y,3x-e^y)$，$f$ 有连续偏导数，求 $(z_x,z_y)$。
analysis_md:
设 $u=x^2y,v=3x-e^y$，则

$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\cdot2xy+\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\cdot3=f_1'+2xyf_2'+3f_3'$

$\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\cdot0+\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\cdot x^2-\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\cdot e^y=x^2f_2'-e^yf_3'$
